Release Notes for XDR🔗

3.9.27 (November 5, 2026)🔗

Features

Cases Closed Status Reason: You can now see the optional Close Reason entered when a case was closed by hovering over the Info icon next to the status in the Cases table and case details.

IDR NHI Details Activity Log: For IDR customers, non-human identity (NHI) details pages now have an Activity Log section that shows authentication and cloud audit events related to the identity.

Threat Intel Explorer Indicators: For users opted into Preview mode, Threat Intelligence Explorer now has an Indicators tab that lists indicators of compromise (IOC) provided by the CTU.

Fixes

Cases Name Filter: Fixed an issue where the Name filter did not return cases with Windows paths in their titles.

Copy Link in Safari: Fixed an issue where Copy Link options throughout XDR did not copy links to the clipboard in Safari.

Docs

Sophos AI Defense: Instructions for signing up for a free trial of the new Sophos AI Defense (AID) feature are now available.

3.9.26 (October 29, 2026)🔗

Features

IDR Integration Health Status and Reason: For IDR customers, each integration now reports a health status. When an integration is not healthy, IDR shows the reasons why and the action you can take to fix it, so you can resolve most issues without contacting Support.

Fixes

Add Evidence to Case: Fixed an issue where incorrect modal placement prevented users from adding evidence to an existing case.

Docs

Business Email Compromise: The documentation has been updated with comprehensive detector information.

3.9.25 (October 22, 2026)🔗

Features

Identity Updates: The following updates have been made to IDR:

Device details pages have been redesigned and now show the device summary in one tab and findings associated with the device in another.

Group details pages have been redesigned and now show a section with tabs for users, groups, NHIs, and devices that are members of the group in the Summary tab.

Entity details pages now show a Fingerprint icon and risk score for entities enriched with identity data from IDR.

MFA Temporary Code: We have removed the option to send a temporary code to your email instead of entering a code from your enrolled authenticator app during the login process.

Live Endpoint Search: Live Endpoint Search in XDR is now generally available.

Fixes

Login Page in Microsoft Edge: Fixed an issue that could prevent the XDR login page from loading in Microsoft Edge.

Endpoint Response Actions: Some endpoint response actions were unavailable on endpoint details pages even when those actions were available for the host elsewhere in XDR. This has been fixed.

Multiple Case Attachments: Fixed an issue where uploading multiple file attachments to a case resulted in an error and duplicate attachments.

Related Process Data: The Related Process Data section in some Sophos Endpoint file modification event details could display an error and fail to load data. This has been fixed.

Cases Table Pinned Columns: Fixed an issue where pinned columns in the Cases table did not persist when the page was refreshed.

Docs

Veeam Backup & Replication: Guidance on integrating Veeam Backup & Replication data into Secureworks® Taegis™ XDR is now available.

3.9.24 (October 15, 2026)🔗

Fixes

Taegis XDR User Admin Summary: We have fixed an issue that stopped users from creating this report.

Docs

Cisco Umbrella Integration Guide: The instructions to integrate Cisco Umbrella via customer-managed S3 bucket have been corrected.

3.9.23 (October 8, 2026)🔗

Features

Full Screen Search Results: You can now click Full Screen above Data Lake Search results to see them in a larger view.

Process Trees Related Events: All users can now view events related to a process node in the Process Tree view.

Live Endpoint Search: Users opted into Preview mode can now use Live Endpoint Search natively in XDR to query their devices with the Sophos Agent.

Fixes

Identity Overview: The dashboard was showing findings for disabled posture checks. This has been fixed.

Docs

Non-Human Identity Details: Documentation of non-human identity details in Taegis™ IDR is now available and includes background information about Microsoft Entra Agent ID objects.

3.9.22 (October 1, 2026)🔗

Features

AI Expression Assistant: The new AI Expression Assistant, which helps you create CEL expressions from natural language descriptions in supported XDR workflows, is now generally available.

Inventory Information Event Schema: A new Inventory Information event schema reports device inventory data that's either logged or proactively collected.

Process Trees Related Events: Users opted into Preview mode can now view events related to a process node in the Process Tree view.

Fixes

Data Retention: Organization data retention wasn’t appearing on the Subscriptions page as expected. This has been fixed.

3.9.21 (September 24, 2026)🔗

Features

AI Expression Assistant: Users opted in to Preview mode can now use the AI Expression Assistant to create CEL expressions from natural language descriptions in supported XDR workflows.

Fixes

No Data in Case Response Widget: For some tenants, the Case Response widget on the Security Posture Dashboard was not loading data. This has been fixed.

3.9.20 (September 17, 2026)🔗

Features

Identity Overview MFA Coverage Widget: The MFA Coverage widget now excludes on-premises Active Directory identities, which don't support native MFA.

Fixes

IDR Setup: After granting consent in Microsoft Entra during the IDR setup workflow, users were not redirected back to the setup wizard in XDR. This has been fixed.

Docs

Supported CEL Macros: All supported CEL macros are now documented.

Identity Response Actions: Guidance for configuring on-premises automations and response actions is now available.

3.9.19 (September 10, 2026)🔗

Features

Rubrik Integration: You can now configure a Rubrik integration.

Fixes

Custom Widgets: Some users were prevented from creating custom widgets when a query matched multiple event data types. This has been fixed.

Taegis MDR Dashboard: Some mean time analytics on the Taegis MDR Dashboard were missing data for certain months. This has been fixed.

3.9.18 (September 3, 2026)🔗

Features

Identity Manually-Added Domains: For IDR subscribers, credential leak monitoring now supports manual domain management and DNS TXT verification, allowing administrators to add, verify, monitor, and remove domains individually.

Identity Authentication Locations: For IDR subscribers, we've added a search bar and IP address pivot search to the Authentication Locations section of the Identity Details Activity Log tab.

Forensic Information Event Schema: A new Forensic Information event schema returns forensic information that's been pulled, queried, or discovered on a device, including Windows services and startup items.

Fixes

Case Details: Case details now render correctly on mobile devices.

3.9.17 (August 27, 2026)🔗

Fixes

Attach Files to Cases: You can attach multiple files at once to cases again.

IDR Response Actions: Some users experienced a duplicate provider error when configuring Entra ID Response Actions in IDR. This has been fixed.

Docs

Detection Suppression Rules: New documentation explains how detection suppression works.

Cases API Guides: The Investigations v2 API is now deprecated. Use the new Cases GraphQL API instead.

3.9.16 (August 20, 2026)🔗

Features

Taegis™ IDR Identity Overview: The Identity Overview page has been redesigned and enhanced with new widgets that show an organization-level view of identity risk.

Taegis™ IDR Posture Check Preferences: The Posture Check Preferences tab has been redesigned with a table view and additional filters to find specific posture checks.

Fixes

Completed Reports: Fixed an issue where the Completed Reports tab showed only the first 100 reports. You can now view all available completed reports.

Custom Connector Publishing: Fixed an issue where the Custom Connector publishing panel could close before it reported a save failure.

3.9.15 (August 13, 2026)🔗

Features

Process Search Enhancement: You can now use the IN operator to search for specific processes in Lineage and Process Tree views.

Patch State Information Event Schema: A new Patch State Information event schema reports the installation of an OS patch to a device and any associated knowledge base articles.

API Credential Role: You can now specify the user role permissions applied to API credentials you add in Manage API Credentials. Previously the role defaulted to Tenant Analyst.

Fixes

Query Builder Export: The Export All as CSV action in Query Builder event search results was not generating an export. This has been fixed.

3.9.14 (August 6, 2026)🔗

Features

Enhanced Cases Experience: The following enhancements to review, manage, and respond to cases are now generally available:

A new case summary view

New case details header

New Response tab

Both manual and automatic case templates

Identity On-Premise Active Directory: On-Premise Active Directory is now a supported Identity Provider for IDR, in addition to Microsoft Entra. On-Premise AD allows you to deploy the Sophos ITDR sensor to extend identity security monitoring to your on-premise AD environment.

Fixes

Cisco Duo Federal: Sophos XDR now accepts Cisco Duo Federal API hostnames (for example, api-abc12345.duofederal.com) in addition to standard Cisco Duo hostnames.

3.9.13 (July 30, 2026)🔗

Features

Event Lineage Process Trees: The process tree view of an event lineage is now available to all users.

Enhanced Cases Experience: For users opted in to Preview mode, the following enhancements make it faster to review, manage, and respond to cases:

Case Summary View: When you click a case on the Cases page, a slide-out shows a new summary view of the case's key information, including the case header, Case Summary, Key Findings, Timeline, and Comments. This lets you triage and review a case without losing your place.

Case Details Page: Case details pages have been redesigned with a new header of key attributes across the top of the page, and reorganized Case Summary, Key Findings, and Case Details sections on the Overview tab.

Response Tab: A new Response tab on case details pages give you a centralized place to see and perform configured response actions on the entities associated with the case.

Case Templates: Case templates now support both manual and automatic cases and can now be found at Cases > Templates.

Docs

Microsoft Defender XDR Integration Guide: A new section for updating a migrated integration has been added to the guide, along with additional details throughout. The legacy Defender guides have been removed.

Azure Data Collector: Information about the updated ARM template has been added to the configuration notes.

3.9.12 (July 23, 2026)🔗

Features

Process Trees: Users opted into Preview mode can now view a process lineage as a process tree. The process tree is a top-down view of the process lineage for users who want a rapid visualization of the parent process, as well as all its children and siblings.

Copy Advanced Searches: You can now copy an Advanced Search query to your clipboard from the AI Search and the Query Editor by clicking the Copy icon .

Identity Updates: Many updates have been made to IDR and the Identity docs, including:

Identities now include an Identity Risk Score, which indicates the overall level of risk associated with each identity.

The Identity Details Activity Log tab has been redesigned.

New Identity FAQs have been added.

Fixes

Detections table: The Detections table was occasionally timing out during loading. This has been fixed.

Top Risky Users: The Top Risky Users widget wasn’t loading data fully. This has been fixed.

3.9.11 (July 16, 2026)🔗

Features

Playbook Execution Outcome Details: You can now hover over the Outcome in playbook execution tables throughout XDR to see a tooltip with details.

AWS Data Collector: The CloudFormation template used for configuring AWS data collectors has been simplified. For information on migrating to the new template, see Legacy Template Notes.

IDR App Permissions: For IDR customers, application details pages now include tables of application and delegated permissions.

Claroty xDome Integration: Taegis™ XDR for OT customers can now configure a Claroty xDome integration.

Fixes

Taegis XDR Trends Report: Fixed an issue where the Data Usage by Billing Cycle section was missing from Taegis XDR Trends Reports.

Identity Finding Details: Identity finding details now load without error.

Docs

Automation Connector Credentials: Documentation that explains how connector credentials are stored, protected, accessed, and retired is now available.

Integration Event Time and Time Zone Handling: This new document explains how the platform determines an event's time from integration logs, how included or excluded time zones affect that value, and what to do when event timestamps look incorrect.

Power BI for XDR: The Power BI template has been updated with fixes and improvements.

3.9.10 (July 9, 2026)🔗

Fixes

Resolved Detections: The Detections table now has live refresh, so you don't have to manually refresh the page after resolving detections.

3.9.9 (July 2, 2026)🔗

Features

Escalation Policy Robocall Details: Robocall notifications made for case-related notification rules now include the case type, priority, and title to help you decide whether you need to take immediate action.

Nozomi Vantage Integration: Taegis™ XDR for OT customers can now configure a Nozomi Vantage integration.

3.9.8 (June 25, 2026)🔗

Features

Search a Lineage: The event lineage search, which allows searching across the entire lineage tree and supporting data objects, is now generally available.

Fixes

Identity Failed Logins: The Failed Logins card on an identity's Activity Log tab wasn't returning accurate activity. This has been fixed.

3.9.7 (June 18, 2026)🔗

Features

Identity Findings: IDR findings are now available as detections. By default, critical- and high-risk findings will automatically generate cases assigned to your organization. For more details, see Findings and Cases.

Playbook Execution Outcome: A new Outcome column is available to add to playbook execution tables throughout XDR.

Fixes

Data Source Details Alignment: The content within data source details now aligns correctly.

Docs

Azure Data Collector OS Disk Migration: Guidance is now available for migrating an Azure data collector OS disk from Standard HDD to Standard SSD.

Detection Operation Aliases: Documentation for using detection operation aliases in the Detections API is now available.

3.9.6 (June 11, 2026)🔗

Features

Search a Lineage: Users opted into Preview mode can now search an event lineage across the entire lineage tree and supporting data objects.

Identity Updates: For IDR customers, several updates have been made to the Identity area, including:

Top Sign-in Locations: A new section on the Identity Details page called Top Sign-in Locations maps the user’s top sign-in locations, including counts and breakdowns by public and private IP activity.

Findings Filter: A new filter, Last Modified, is now available on the Identity Findings table.

Configured Integrations: In Identity Settings, the former Cloud API Integrations table is now called Configured Integrations.

Docs

New Schemas: Identity Findings and Software Inventory Information events are now referenced in the Schemas table.

GCP Key Rotation: Steps to rotate your Google Cloud Platform JSON keys have been added.

3.9.5.1 (June 8, 2026)🔗

Docs

Taegis IP Address Ranges: The following guides have been updated with the new XDR IP address ranges used to make inbound connections to your network for the integrations, which should be added to your allow lists. If you previously allowed older IP addresses for these integrations, we recommend removing them after 30 days from this date, unless informed otherwise.

Abnormal Inbound Email Security

Microsoft Azure Event Hubs

Mimecast API 2.0

Okta

3.9.5 (June 4, 2026)🔗

Features

Microsoft Defender XDR Integration: The new Microsoft Defender XDR integration that replaces the legacy Microsoft Defender for Endpoint integration is now available. Customers with the legacy integration will be automatically migrated to the new version with no action required.

Saved Query Categories: You can now add a new saved query category when saving a search in Data Lake Search. You can still add new categories on the Saved Queries page.

3.9.4 (May 28, 2026)🔗

Features

BYOTI Detections: Bring Your Own Threat Intelligence (BYOTI) detection titles now omit schema references to improve accuracy for grouped detections, with Netflow-based detections remaining unchanged.

Docs

HTTP Ingest API: Get Started with the HTTP Ingest API is a new document that defines the request and response semantics of the HTTP Ingest endpoint and provides guidance for building reliable senders against it.

3.9.3 (May 21, 2026)🔗

Features

Delinea Secret Server: You can now integrate Delinea Secret Server audit and security events into Secureworks® Taegis™ XDR.

Fixes

HA Data Collector Host Proxy: The Host Proxy was shown twice on HA Data Collector details pages. This has been fixed.

Docs

Microsoft Graph Security API Alerts: The Microsoft Graph Security API v1 (legacy) and Microsoft Graph Security API Alerts v2 integration guides have been updated to account for Microsoft's deprecation of the v1 API. A new Microsoft Graph Security API Alerts v2 Troubleshooting doc is also now available.

Custom Parser Updates: Custom Parser Syntax has been updated with additional details on LENGTH(), VALIDATE_ALL_JSONPATHS_EXIST(), and indexing. Details on GeoSummary support have been added to Auth Schema, Netflow Schema, and Types Schema.

Sub-processors: The Sub-processors used for Sophos products and services can now be found on the Sophos website.

3.9.2 (May 14, 2026)🔗

Docs

Microsoft Integration Guides: Several Microsoft integration guides were updated recently with instructions on creating Azure applications for ingesting logs. These include Microsoft Azure Activity Logs, Microsoft Entra Risk Detection, and Microsoft Graph Security API Alerts v2.

3.9.1 (May 7, 2026)🔗

Features

Agent Trends Report: The agent counts in the Agent Trends Report now include only agents that send telemetry each day. Agents drop from the count when they stop reporting after one day rather than after 30 days, as was previously the case.

3.9.0.1 (May 1, 2026)🔗

Features

Sophos AI Assistant: The Sophos AI assistant, a generative AI tool that helps you investigate security issues using natural-language prompts, is now generally available.

3.9 (April 30, 2026)🔗

Features

Updates to Cases: The following updates to cases are now generally available:

AI Case Summary: A new AI-generated summary provides a natural language overview of the case based on available case data. For details, see Case Summary.

Case Risk Score: The case risk score provides a visual indicator of case severity, helping you quickly prioritize your investigative work. For details, see Case Risk Score.

Bulk Close Cases: Close multiple cases at once to streamline case management. For details, see Close Multiple Cases.

New Chat Experience: The improved Taegis chat experience is now generally available. For more information, see Taegis Chat.

Fixes

Identity Insights: The Insights tab is loading again as expected.

Saved Queries Filters: The Search Activity filter on the Saved Searches table works consistently again.

Edit Custom Role: The timestamp of a custom role’s last modification now displays the correct date and time.

Command-Line Display: Extra-long command-line prompts on a process event details page are now displayed in a scrollable box instead of being truncated.

Docs

NDR Release Notes: Release notes for NDR are now available.

3.8.25 (April 23, 2026)🔗

Features

Sophos AI Assistant: Tenant Admins opted in to Preview mode can now use the Sophos AI assistant, a generative AI tool that helps you investigate security issues using natural-language prompts.

Updates to Cases: The following updates are now available to users opted in to Preview mode:

AI Case Summary: A new AI-generated summary provides a natural language overview of the case based on available case data. For details, see Case Summary.

Case Risk Score: The case risk score provides a visual indicator of case severity, helping you quickly prioritize your investigative work. For details, see Case Risk Score.

Bulk Close Cases: Close multiple cases at once to streamline case management. For details, see Close Multiple Cases.

Fixes

Missing Packet Capture: Events with packet captures were not showing the data in event details. This has been fixed.

Docs

Infoblox Integration Guide: The Infoblox Integration Guide has updated instructions for ingesting Infoblox BloxOne Threat Defense Data Connector logs.

3.8.24 (April 16, 2026)🔗

Features

New Data Lake Search Experience: Data Lake Search, the new powerful interface for querying detections and events across your tenant, is now generally available. For details on improvements and migration, see Migration from Advanced Search to Data Lake Search.

Fixes

Searching Email Events: Pivot searches weren’t returning results for email addresses contained in @raw data. This has been fixed.

Docs

GCP Shared VPC: The GCP Data Collector documentation has been updated with information about deploying a GCP Shared VPC.

3.8.23 (April 9, 2026)🔗

Features

New Data Lake Search Experience: Users opted into Preview mode can now use Data Lake Search, the new powerful interface for querying detections and events across your tenant. The planned migration date from the current Advanced Search experience to Data Lake Search is April 16, 2026. For details on improvements and migration, see Migration from Advanced Search to Data Lake Search.

3.8.22 (April 2, 2026)🔗

Features

IDR Group Details Enhanced: For IDR customers, Group details pages now show other groups and applications associated with the group.

Fixes

Detection Bulk Actions: Detections could not be closed or added to a case in bulk when selecting all detections from the results of a pivot search. This has been fixed.

3.8.21 (March 26, 2026)🔗

Features

Filter IDR Findings by VIP: For IDR customers, a new identity attribute, Is VIP, is now available as a filter on the Directory and Dark Web Intelligence tables.

New Chat Experience: Users opted into Preview mode can now use our new chat experience, which lets you track conversations across multiple issues while retaining the same core chat functionality.

Docs

XDR Advanced Detectors: New documentation is now available for Advanced Detectors, which are purpose-built detectors that identify sophisticated threats and high-risk exposures across your environment using behavioral analysis, statistical modeling, and evidence correlation.

Office 365 and Azure Data Availability: Our Office 365 and Azure Data Availability document has been updated with more extensive information about how XDR polls Microsoft APIs, which timestamp drives collection versus event time in the product, and when a gap between event time and ingest time is expected.

3.8.20 (March 19, 2026)🔗

Fixes

Custom Role Permission: Fixed an issue where a custom role with a Cloud API Integration permission did not allow the user to see the Cloud API page.

Playbook Configuration Activities: Fixed an issue where a connection set could not be removed when configuring a playbook template's activities.

3.8.19 (March 12, 2026)🔗

Features

IDR VIP Monitoring: VIP Monitoring has left Preview mode and is now generally available to all IDR customers.

Docs

Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Data Collector: The instructions to install and configure a Taegis™ XDR Collector for GCP have been updated.

3.8.18 (March 5, 2026)🔗

Fixes

Error Opening Entity from Detection: Fixed an issue where opening an endpoint entity from a detection in a new tab could fail with an error.

IDR Identity Insights: Fixed an issue where the Insights tab in Identity details did not show any detections despite there being detection counts for the user shown on the Identity Risk Posture Overview.

Data Source Details Issues: Fixed misaligned Sensor Type values in the Data Source Details drawer and an issue where the drawer unexpectedly closed after clicking a link in the drawer when opened from Log Collector details.

3.8.17 (February 26, 2026)🔗

Features

Detector Explorer: Detector Explorer has left Preview mode and is now generally available to all users. It also includes expanded filtering to help you review detector coverage and identify coverage gaps.

MITRE ATT&CK Detection Table Filter: The Detections table now includes an expanded MITRE ATT&CK filter that uses the full, up-to-date MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Matrix, allowing you to filter detections in your tenant by tactic and technique.

New Advanced Search Functions: Advanced Search Query Language now supports tolower and toupper to normalize string field values to lowercase or uppercase when grouping data. This enables case-insensitive aggregations and consistent grouping regardless of the original case of the data. For more information, see Query Editor.

Threat Score Threat Intelligence Factors: Threat Score now factors threat intelligence from VirusTotal and APIVoid into its calculations. For more information, see Threat Score.

Fixes

Endpoint Agents Summary: The table now sorts correctly by creation date when you sort by the Created At column.

3.8.16 (February 19, 2026)🔗

Features

Sophos Linux Sensor: Sophos Linux Sensor is now available for all XDR tenants.

Host Entity Information: Structured Host entities in detections now show the unique Host ID instead of the Sensor ID.

Fixes

Structured Entities: A bug causing Target Entities to be categorized as Source Entities in Identity Authorization events has been fixed.

3.8.15 (February 12, 2026)🔗

Features

IDR Credential Compromise Now Named Dark Web Intelligence: The Credential Compromise page of IDR is now named Dark Web Intelligence.

Threat Lineage: The Lineage view in event details has been enhanced with Key Activities and Related Events sub-tabs.

Fixes

Accessing Sophos Fusion: Fixed an issue where clicking the Sophos Fusion button on the Endpoint Agents Summary page could fail to open Sophos Fusion in some environments.

Docs

IDR Integration Guide: The documentation for integrating IDR now includes details on how to complete setup if initial admin consent fails. For more information, see the IDR Integration Guide.

Taegis MDR Proactive Response and Automation Playbooks: The Proactive Response and Automations Playbooks documentation now includes guidance on playbook action pre-authorization for Proactive Response. When using Playbooks with Proactive Response, you can pre-authorize only one response action per action type. For details, see Proactive Response Actions Overview, and Configured Playbooks.

3.8.14 (February 5, 2026)🔗

Fixes

Advanced Search History: A bug causing Advanced Search History results not to load when using Safari has been fixed.

Timeline of Related Detections & Events: Events weren't loading in the Timeline of Related Detections & Events if the default timeframe was adjusted. This has been fixed.

3.8.13 (January 29, 2026)🔗

Features

Sophos Endpoint Agent for macOS: Sophos Agent for macOS is now available for all XDR tenants, following a period in Early Access. For more information, see the Sophos Agent Introduction.

Threat Intelligence Explorer:

You can now search through all malware, threat reports, and threat groups in the Threat Intelligence Explorer using the search field at the top of the page.

You can now link directly to malware details, threat reports, and threat groups by opening the details in a new tab and copying the URL.

When using the Japanese language UI, threat report titles are now returned in Japanese.

Fixes

Case Filters: Fixed an issue where toggling Show Archived could cause Case table filters such as Priority and Type to stay stuck in a loading state until the page was refreshed.

Cases PDF Exports: Fixed an issue that truncated tables in exported case PDFs when the case’s key findings included a table.

Docs

Carbon Black Response Cloud Integration: Documentation related to Carbon Black Response Cloud integration has been removed as it is no longer supported.

3.8.12 (January 22, 2026)🔗

Features

IDR My Environment Now Named Directory: The My Environment page of IDR is now named Directory.

Fixes

eStreamer Configuration: Modifying an eStreamer configuration now works as expected.

3.8.11 (January 15, 2026)🔗

Docs

Taegis MDR Proactive Response: The Proactive Response documentation has been updated to reflect the current workflow.

Check Point Harmony Email Security Integration Guide: The integration steps of this guide have been updated.

3.8.10 (January 8, 2026)🔗

Features

IDR Regrant Admin Consent: Users can now regrant admin consent for the Identity Application in Entra from the Identity Settings page.

Check Point Harmony Email Security Integration: Users opted into Preview mode can now access the Check Point Harmony Email integration. For more information, see the Check Point Harmony Email Security Integration Guide.

Docs

Zscaler Integration: The Zscaler Integration Guide now includes details for Cloud NSS integration via HTTP Ingest.

3.8.9 (December 18, 2025)🔗

Features

Update Registered Email Address: You can now edit the email address registered to your XDR account in User Profile & Settings. For more information, see User Profile & Settings.

Fixes

Cloud API Integrations: Fixed an issue preventing users with appropriate permissions from editing Cloud API integrations.

Custom Dashboards: Fixed an issue in Custom Dashboards where Detection Volume Trend widgets appeared blank in generated reports. Charts now display correctly and match the dashboard view.

Docs

Microsoft Graph Security API v2 Integration: Documentation for integrating Microsoft Graph Security API v2 is now available. Microsoft Graph Security API v2 supersedes the v1 integration. The v1 integration will be discontinued by April 2026.

3.8.8 (December 11, 2025)🔗

Features

Case Key Findings: A warning message now displays if you try to navigate away from a case while editing the Key Findings, ensuring you’ve saved your work first.

3.8.7.1 (December 5, 2025)🔗

Features

AlienVault OTX Integration Now Legacy: The AlienVault OTX integration is now legacy. New AlienVault OTX integrations can no longer be configured, but existing integrations will continue to function.

Docs

IDR Integration Guide: The integration instructions for initial Taegis™ IDR setup have been updated.

3.8.7 (December 4, 2025)🔗

Features

Microsoft Defender Endpoint Agent Health: Microsoft Defender endpoints that report an Inactive asset status now show their Agent Health as Needs Attention instead of Critical in XDR.

Fixes

Executive Summary Report Data Export: The data export for Executive Summary Reports can now be downloaded as designed.

Taegis™ NDR Change Management Report PDF: Taegis™ NDR Change Management Report PDFs now contain the expected contents.

Taegis XDR Trends Report Translation: The translation of the Taegis XDR Trends Report has been improved.

Case Closed Status: Fixed an issue where the case status had to be selected twice when closing a case.

Long Command Line in Detection: Fixed an issue where the page became unresponsive when viewing a detection with a long command line.

Detection Flow Widget: The Tenant and Tenant ID columns in the expanded view of the Detection Flow widget now populate as expected.

3.8.6 (November 20, 2025)🔗

Features

Sophos Endpoint Agent: Sophos Agent for macOS is now available for all XDR tenants. For more information, see So [truncated for CSV - full text is in the JSON export]
